facts.text: Serve the mains when Rod calls Jerry from the kitchen in Arizona.
facts.why: Rod is on the phone with Jerry and makes him yell the family motto, but no source says he is in a kitchen. The call is the Show me the money scene.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Rod makes Jerry yell 'Show me the money' down the phone.

facts.text: I wrote the memo at three in the morning on a lot of coffee. It cost me my job, but I kept the goldfish and the takeaway menus.
facts.why: Jerry says he wrote a mission statement, not a memo, one night, and walks out saying the fish are coming with him. Three in the morning, coffee and takeaway menus are not in the film.
facts.fix: I wrote it overnight. It was a mission statement, not a memo. It cost me my job, but the fish came with me.
